messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Comparing r^2 in Lavaan
parts: Is anyone aware of a way to label a variable's r^2 to include it in a lavTestWald function?

R-sq is not a model parameter.  It is a function of model parameters, so if you understand your model well enough to define it using the := operator, you can run a Wald test on it.  Or you can write a custom function that grabs the R-sq output you want from parameterEstimates() and return the quantity you want to test, then use bootstrapLavaan() to estimate an empirical distribution for it.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
